title: TouchScale
about: Two full-hand tactile gloves (880 taxels each), a head RGB-D camera and two wrist cameras; 15,324 episodes of 929 tasks in 22 scene types, 100 of a planned 500 hours. 8 episodes from 8 scenes are shown.

hardware.d: 880 taxels on 15 pads per hand · normal force in N plus two tangential components per taxel · 30–100 Hz, timestamped

hardware.v: Head Orbbec Gemini 345Lg + 2 wrist RealSense D405
hardware.d: 1280×720 · 30 fps · head depth registered to the head RGB, 16-bit mm
About 200 Hz accelerometer and gyro · one English instruction per episode · 193 textured meshes

notes: Paper: arXiv 2610.10288. Released by 2077AI under CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use with attribution); gated on Hugging Face with automatic approval. Each episode is read out of the release's 2.5 GB WebDataset shards by byte range; its videos are re-encoded and hosted here, credited to the TouchScale authors.
